incidente.resumo: On August 29, 2019, a single order for 10 lakh units of a penny stock on BSE was executed in more than 1 lakh individual trades, which overloaded Zerodha's order management system (OMS) from Thomson Reuters (now Refinitiv); order placement had issues between 10.00 and 10.40 AM, and some clients faced extra margin blocks until positions were reconciled with the exchanges. The text does not say how order placement was restored; it says order placements resumed after 10.40 AM.

descricao.texto: A single order for 10 lakh quantity on a sub Rs 1 stock on BSE, placed around 9.40 AM, was executed in more than 1 lakh individual trades instead of the usual up to several hundred, which caused an overload in the OMS.
trechos: It is normal for a large single order to get executed in multiple trades at the exchanges, usually up to several hundred trades.

But today, a single order for 10 lakh quantity placed at around 9.40 AM on a sub Rs 1 stock (penny stock) on BSE got executed in almost 1+ lakh individual trades. This is unprecedented and caused an overload in the OMS.

passos.texto: Overall positions were reconciled with the exchanges, ending the additional margin blocks for clients whose open orders executed during the affected period.
trechos: Order placements resumed after that, but clients who had open orders from before 10.00 AM that got executed at the exchanges during the affected period, faced issues with additional margin blocks until we could reconcile the overall positions with the exchanges.

acoes.texto: In progress: the OMS vendor Refinitiv is working on a fix to the OMS to handle such cases.
trechos: Refinitiv is working on a fix to the OMS to handle cases like this.

acoes.texto: Until the fix, the maximum allowed quantity per order for equity trades is limited to 20,000; larger quantities must be entered as multiple orders.
trechos: Until then, we are limiting the maximum allowed quantity per order for equity trades to 20,000.
If a client has to enter or exit larger quantities, it would have to be done in multiple orders of 20,000 quantity.

acoes.texto: Planned: launch basket orders on Kite so creating multiple 20,000-quantity orders is not inconvenient.
trechos: We will soon launch basket orders on Kite to ensure it is not inconvenient to create multiple orders of 20,000 for a particular stock.
Between 10.00 and 10.40 AM today, we faced technical issues with our order management system (OMS).

observacoes: The order was placed around 9.40 AM and the OMS issues lasted from 10.00 to 10.40 AM; extra margin blocks for some clients lasted until positions were reconciled, at a time the text does not give. The text does not say how detection happened or what was done to restore order placement. The 20,000 quantity limit affects less than 0.02% of clients.
